analysis_state: formula and exact-schema reader frozen before new quartet counts; source identity pending producer completion
source_access: Only a producer-confirmed complete immutable source commit containing all forty gzip files
population: Original 20,000 prefixes per N325/N425, twenty original batches of 1,000; no R1-only denominator
replication: Two independently chosen common next labels U,V; two independent suffixes per label; each suffix order paired across the original two orientations
observer_definition: A=1-(K1+K2)/(N+1); E=1-(K2-K1)/(N+1); paired means (first-second)/the existing delta_cos4
orientation: Keep the original first-minus-second/delta_cos4 sign in X and retain 01/10 separately; raw pooled low-minus-high alignment is delta_cos4 times the linear 01-minus-10 combination
gate_response_covariance: half (g_U-g_V)(m_U-m_V)^T, where m averages the two independent suffixes of that label
denominator: Average the eight quartets at each prefix, zero-pad noncell prefixes, then divide every original batch by 1000
uncertainty: Retain joint twenty-batch sufficient vectors for the single shared covariance coordinator; no independent cell or agent evidence blocks
fixed_roles: A 0->2 jump counts as the R0 first birth, including a simultaneous second birth; R1->2 is the higher-rank gate
forbidden: population rate-product substituted for within-prefix covariance
boundary: The common label is the pre-existing CRN coupling of these two geometries, not an intrinsic identification of positions in all embeddings
